conclusion: All 26 requested native GUI tests passed against the installed application, with successful managed process exits and runtime proof that production core and TechDraw images came from the installed bundle.

runtime_provenance.method: Each disposable test-only wrapper asserts AppHomePath, installed resource-directory containment and exact revision. After importing its test and support modules it enumerates the process's actual dyld images using _dyld_image_count/_dyld_get_image_name, asserts that every matching core/TechDraw image is inside installed Resources, and requires libFreeCADGui, TechDraw and TechDrawGui to be present. It prints an INSTALLED_NATIVE_PRECHECK JSON receipt before the unittest suite runs.
runtime_provenance.test_only_support_origin: The two non-installed native seam bridges come from build/release/tests. They are explicitly permitted test instrumentation, not source application/production modules. Their presence does not replace the installed library provenance assertions.

test_isolation.notification_policy_control: The existing cancelled-close regression temporarily disables ordinary hide-on-deactivation solely to distinguish a rejected-close cleanup from normal popup hiding, then restores stock hide-on-deactivation=true for the actual ordinary-error/shutdown test. Non-intrusive notifications remain enabled.

suites.name: NotificationBoxShutdownTest
suites.coverage: Actual unsaved-document Cancel preserves the modified disposable document and popup. An ordinary native Console error then creates an actual visible popup with stock hide-on-deactivation=true. Its destruction and successful complete process exit qualify installed shutdown, not just successful test assertions.

suites.name: PagePrinterTest
suites.coverage: Actual installed PagePrinter methods: incomplete-batch/no-output/sentinel safety for both devices, empty batch, initialized inactive/tabless compatibility, common graphics-template interface, nested exporting/modified restoration, actual template update failure with ScreenMode/LightOnDark restoration and successful recovery, PDF list preflight and unchanged last-page-only semantics.

suites.name: TestTechDrawGui
suites.coverage: Installed stock TechDraw GUI suite, including the existing four d0u single-page output/inactive/tabless guards and the ordinary drawing view/dimension/section controls.

completion_checks.process_inventory_check: ps -Ao pid,command matched no installed Contents/MacOS/FreeCAD or Contents/Resources/bin/FreeCAD process after all three managed runs.

fixture_qualification.initial_precheck_attempt: An overly strict assertion that getResourceDir equals AppHomePath rejected the first wrapper before any test body ran. The installed layout correctly stores resources under Resources/share rather than Resources itself.
fixture_qualification.correction: Assert exact installed AppHomePath and installed-Resources containment of getResourceDir, while retaining exact revision and actual native-image checks. The final notification run used new private config filenames, not the rejected attempt's configs.
fixture_qualification.important_gate: A managed exit0 alone is insufficient because pre-test import failure can still exit0. Every final gate requires a successful provenance receipt, the exact expected test count, unittest OK, and process exit0.

limitations: These are automated native installed-app tests, not a new manual print-dialog acceptance or PDF visual inspection. Root separately performed the installed save/cancel/Escape and rendered PDF checks.
Common-template coverage uses an actual QGIDrawingTemplate scene item on valid SVG-sized page geometry; full unfinished parametric-page sizing remains outside the claim.

No production sources, installed files, beads, commits or build targets were modified by this validation. Disposable wrappers and raw receipts remain under the private temporary directory; this JSON preserves their measured results and hashes.
